adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, the reference objects built from `result` were changed so `credentialId` is no longer set for non-calendar integrations. Previously it was `credentialId: isCalendarType ? evt.destinationCalendar?.credentialId : result.credentialId`, but now it is `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined` (and similarly later `credentialId: result.credentialId ?? undefined`). This verifiably drops `result.credentialId` for non-calendar types (e.g., video/conferencing references), which is a behavioral regression introduced by this diff.
